svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Interface: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, three.js, TypeScript. Service: FastAPI 0.143, SQLAlchemy 2, Pydantic 2, PyJWT, bcrypt. Data & triage: PostgreSQL, SQLite, TF-IDF retrieval, Gemini (optional). Quality & delivery: pytest, Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, Neon.
